name: Chemically defined medium (CDM-derived, 10-fold reduced BCAA) (PMC2526093)
description: Chemically defined medium (CDM-derived, 10-fold reduced BCAA) — medium reported in PMC2526093, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC2526093 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification_evidence: Organism/oxygen: 'in anaerobic chemostat cultures (under nitrogen atmosphere)' with L. lactis IL1403. Medium: 'The medium composition (Table 1) is derived from the CDM medium with a ten-fold reduction of Branched-Chain Amino Acid (BCAA) concentrations i.e., valine, leucine, isoleucine.' Table 1 salts include CoCl2.6H2O 0.0025 g/L and cyano-cobalamine (B12) 0.001 g/L as distinct entries; vitamins i

composition_provenance.definition: sourced = the cited source states this component; derived = the pipeline supplied it. Classification table: tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
